messages:
rohan: quick check-in on the Dedicated/Onprem outage postmortem follow-ups. goal: lock owners, narrow timelines, and surface any cross-customer recurring failure modes.

emily: FYI customer was seeing peering drops + stale tenant namespaces causing 503s. postmortem linked in tracker. we need short-term mitigations for affected customers and long-term fixes.

sasha: i'll own the short-term customer mitigations (routing policy + avoid-az rules). can deliver config and rollback plan by Tue 2026-04-06 EOD.

devon: i'll own peering hardening (BGP hold-time tuning + bgp session auto-restart) + a peering preflight job. target PR + runbook draft by 2026-04-11.

oncall-bot: Postmortem: INC-2026-077 published: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-077 Action items added to remediation board.

marta: isolation bug deep-dive: looks like namespace reclaim raced with socket close on older kernels. plan: add conservative reclaim delay + feature-flag rollout for affected clusters. hoping for patch and canary by 2026-04-04.

rohan: good. recording explicit action items here (will paste to tracker):

- R1: Short-term customer routing policy (avoid problematic AZs) owner: sasha due: 2026-04-06 success: customer confirms lower error rate and accepts waiver
- R2: Peering hardening + runbook owner: devon due: 2026-04-11 success: runbook + automated preflight check in CI
- R3: Namespace reclaim patch + canary owner: marta due: 2026-04-04 success: canary traffic 5k reqs over 48h without repro
- R4: Backport compatibility note for on-prem kernels owner: marta due: 2026-04-08 success: docs + compatibility matrix entry
- R5: Synthetic peering-flap test in staging + alert integration owner: emily due: 2026-04-15 success: alert fires on simulated flap and links to runbook
- R6: Cross-team retro on recurring isolation patterns owner: rohan due: 2026-04-09 success: list of 3 systemic mitigations (tests/telemetry/tools)

emily: i'll add the synthetic to staging runner and wire it to PagerDuty for a test alert.

sasha: on the customer side, i need devon and marta to review the temporary routing rules for side-effects before i push.

marta: will review. note: reclaim backoff must be configurable per-cluster for older on-prem kernels. i'll include opt-in feature-flag PR.

devon: ack. i'll include a checklist item: "validate routing policy interaction with peering BGP restarts" in the runbook.

oncall-bot: Reminder: weekly remediation board sync scheduled Thu 10:00.

rohan: final ask: please update the tracker rows with PR links and ETA changes by EOD tomorrow. i'll ping again on 2026-04-07. thanks all :thumbsup
